identity: ONE original stocky dwarf, the Sumpstone Guard, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the short-legged body, the braided red beard, the metal helmet with a round cyan headlamp, the dark fractured stone plate armour with brass seams, the blue tabard and the violet and cyan crystals on the shoulders. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. The screen-LEFT hand holds ONE short pickaxe with two rigid curved crystal pick tips; the screen-RIGHT arm carries ONE tall kite-shaped faceted crystal shield in navy, cyan, white and violet with a brass rim. Preserve the pickaxe, the crystal shield, the beard and the stocky proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full helmet, the whole pickaxe, the whole shield, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated GREEN throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The green background stays the same flat saturated green in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, glow bursts, sparkles, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra limbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; the shield stays a rigid crystal slab with the same colours and never morphs.

idle_h3_v1.action: A steady, watchful idle that loops. The dwarf breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, the pickaxe turns a little in the low hand, the shield settles on the arm and the helmeted head turns slightly to scan, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no attack.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE pickaxe blow toward screen right. The dwarf raises the pickaxe high overhead as the knees bend, then steps into a lunge and swings it down in front of the shield to full reach at screen right, draws back and settles into the original stance. One blow only; no sparks or effect at contact.

hit_h3_v1.action: The dwarf starts rocked back in a flinch and recovers from it. The head and shoulders twist back behind the shield and the knees flex while both hands keep hold of the pickaxe and the shield, then he steadies on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Crouch low behind the crystal shield, setting it forward in front of the body with the shoulder braced against it and the pickaxe held low, then hold the braced guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A rallying signal. The dwarf raises the pickaxe high overhead as a signal, the shield held steady, holds the pose briefly, then lowers it back to the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly and heavily. The dwarf sinks onto both knees leaning on the shield, stays kneeling a moment, then topples over and lies flat on his side, finishing motionless with the helmet at screen right, the shield lying against the body and the pickaxe on the ground beside it. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
